title: V-SHELL — shell polish, service worker hardening, app icons
desc:
DELIVERABLE: index.html / app/app.js / app/app.css / app/sw.js refined against CONTRACT.md §3–§5 (the shipped skeleton is a starting point, not a spec). Required behaviour: header freshness dot+banner correct for the 45/120-min thresholds; retry/backoff on every fetch (8s timeout); service worker caches shell + last good state.json (network-first for state, cache-first shell) and updates cleanly (bump VERSION); tabs swap without page reload; installing via Chrome 'Add to Home screen' opens standalone with the vigil icon. Keep: no frameworks, no CDN, no network fonts.
EVIDENCE: node --check on every JS file; in the PR: screenshot or transcript of the app open with the sample state via python3 tools/serve.py; Lighthouse-ish manual list: installable (manifest+SW+icons), offline reload shows last good state with badge.
OWNS: index.html, app/app.js, app/app.css, app/sw.js, icons/*
BRANCH: agent/<you>/<task-id>

history.note: V-SHELL delivered @c0fb3f9 (vigil PR #1; vigil is NOT paused — tag vigil): the four real contract gaps closed — wires fetch now has 8s timeout + retries via one shared helper (4.2), offline badge on cold-offline loads (4.5), SW v6 best-effort install + awaited cache writes (one flaky icon no longer kills the SW), 48px touch targets + focus-visible + reduced-motion (4.6). Evidence: node --check all JS; serve.py transcript in docs/; smoke.mjs green live AND in new OFFLINE=1 mode (SW-cache simulation asserting the offline badge). Views untouched.
